changelog: Stops every update from resetting the 'Comfort Entities' dashboard. Since v23, zones_dashboard.json was bundled with each release and applied wholesale via cytech_update.sh's apply_dashboard(), silently overwriting any UI customization (rearranged cards, renamed zones, and entities added after discovery -- e.g. the bridge addon's Response buttons). zones_dashboard.json and the long-stale welcome_dashboard.json (which was anyway failing every update with a FileNotFoundError since the welcome dashboard became YAML-mode) are removed from the manifest, and their apply_dashboard() calls are removed from cytech_update.sh. Storage dashboards now stay exactly as the user left them; entities discovered by the bridge addon are still auto-created by Home Assistant and can be added to the dashboard in the UI without being overwritten. The apply_dashboard() helper remains in cytech_update.sh for any future one-off storage-dashboard push (and its next release must then drop the json from the manifest again, or it re-applies forever). No dashboard content is changed by this update -- only the pipeline stops touching it.
